from slugify import slugify

def test_replacements_iterable_both_passes():
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=iter([('-', '+')])) == 'a+b'
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=[('-', '+')]) == 'a+b'
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=iter([('-', '+'), ('+', '=')])) == 'a=b'
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=[('-', '+'), ('+', '=')]) == 'a=b'

def test_replacements_one_shot_rules():
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=iter([iter(['-', '+'])])) == 'a+b'
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=[iter(['-', '+'])]) == 'a+b'

def test_stopwords_iterable():
    assert slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=iter(['Drop']), lowercase=False) == 'Keep-Tail'
    assert slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=['Drop'], lowercase=False) == 'Keep-Tail'
    assert slugify('Drop Keep Tail', stopwords=iter(['Drop']), lowercase=False) == 'Keep-Tail'
    assert slugify('Drop Keep Tail', stopwords=['Drop'], lowercase=False) == 'Keep-Tail'
    assert slugify('Drop Keep Tail', stopwords=iter(['drop']), lowercase=True) == 'Keep-Tail'
    assert slugify('Drop Keep Tail', stopwords=['drop'], lowercase=True) == 'Keep-Tail'

def test_none_and_empty():
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=None) == 'a-b'
    assert slugify('a b', stopwords=None) == 'a-b'
    assert slugify('a b', replacements=[]) == 'a-b'
    assert slugify('a b', stopwords=[]) == 'a-b'

def test_no_mutation():
    repl = [[ '-', '+']]
    slugify('a b', replacements=repl)
    assert repl == [[ '-', '+']]
    sw = ['Drop']
    slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=sw, lowercase=False)
    assert sw == ['Drop']

def test_existing_behavior():
    assert slugify('Hello World') == 'hello-world'
    assert slugify('Hello World', max_length=5) == 'hello'
    assert slugify('Hello World', max_length=5, word_boundary=True) == 'hello'
    assert slugify('Hello World', separator='_') == 'hello_world'
    assert slugify('a,b,c', decimal=False) == 'a-b-c'
